today_paragraph: GE HealthCare is at $71.03, up 2.9% today. Price is back above its 20-day average, but the longer trend hasn't turned up yet. The overall score is leaning bullish (+37), with one caution on the daily chart: 20-bar average below 50-bar (downtrend). Options look expensive, assuming 58% yearly volatility versus 26% the stock has actually shown. The options market expects a move of about ±7% by Oct 30. Next up: GE HealthCare earnings (before open) in 6 days. Earnings have moved it about ±7% on average. Option prices often drop sharply right after the report.
